body: Maybe the default verbosity should be louder. Tagged. Thanks!
Thanks :-) How can I manually increase the verbosity level in the meantime?
I've been scratching my head with this; glad I'm not the only one.

As a little it of additional info, I downgraded my Ansible package to 1.2.3 and verbose mode was back.

I've tried out v1.3.0 and 1.3.1 of Ansible and in both cases, I have no output.
@jamiecurle yep, exactly the same as what I'm seeing.

Have just installed 1.3.2 and I'm still seeing the issue. I note that the output is now `verbose` by default but I still don't see task execution as it happens; it is still dumped either all at the end or at seemingly random intervals.

IMO the default output level doesn't need to be verbose.

If I attempt to provision using `ansible-playbook` manually then I see output on a task-by-task basis, i.e.

```
$ ansible-playbook \
    ~/Development/orchestration/foo.yml \
    -i ~/Development/orchestration/development/inventory \
    -u vagrant \
    --private-key=~/.vagrant.d/insecure_private_key
```

This is using Ansible **1.3.0**.

cc: @cbanbury

I'm experiencing the same issue as @jabclab 

Vagrant 1.3.2
Ansible 1.3.0
I'm not sure what is going wrong then... @cmdtab any idea?

This is definitely still broken with:

ansible 1.3.1
vagrant 1.3.3

Please reopen

Works as expected with:

```
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
```

found here:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/ansible-project/aXutTmXAbR0

issue.title: Default Ansible provisioner verbosity should not be `--verbose`

repository.name: vagrant
repository.description: Vagrant is a tool for building and distributing development environments.

issue.body:
I think the default verbosity of the Ansible provisioner should no longer default to `--verbose`. I personally feel it makes more sense to use default verbosity of Ansible and only increase if specified in the `Vagrantfile`.

This is effectively reverting https://github.com/mitchellh/vagrant/commit/ee9fc00a046f62efa5b9a63c061383644e55aaed. This change was made as part of efforts to resolve https://github.com/mitchellh/vagrant/issues/2194.

body:
Same problems for me
Vagrant 1.3.1
ansible 1.4.1

This fixed it for me

```
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
```
